span.p:
control
cycles = 1 + delay
halted = pc == N
issue = !halted & counter == 0
stall = issue & PULL & fifo_empty
last = issue ? delay == 0 : counter == 1
counter reg, 5 bits, rst → 0
issue & !stall → delay
counter > 0 → counter − 1
